question: In which year was the Amateur Athletics Federation of India (AAFI) formally established to govern athletics in India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**1946**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Amateur Athletics Federation of India (AAFI)** was formally established in the year **1946**.
 
• The AAFI was the **governing body** for athletics in India and was responsible for conducting athletics events and promoting the sport across the country.
 
• The formation of the AAFI marked a major step in the **organization and development** of athletics as a professional and competitive sport in India.
 
• It was later renamed the **Athletics Federation of India (AFI)** to modernize and align with international standards.
 
• The AAFI was affiliated with the **International Amateur Athletic Federation (IAAF)**, now known as World Athletics, to facilitate India’s participation in global athletics events.
 
• The establishment of the AAFI was crucial for representing India in **international competitions** like the Olympics, Asian Games, and Commonwealth Games.
 
• The organization also played a key role in **talent identification and nurturing** athletes who went on to represent India in global events.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Key Points Related to the Correct Answer**__

 
 
• The year **1946** was significant as it was just before India gained independence, and the foundation of sports organizations like AAFI showcased the country’s interest in making a global mark in athletics.
 
• The Athletics Federation of India (AFI) later became a **recognized body** by the Indian Olympic Association (IOA).
